audit_meta.title: CA Cloud Desk CRM Performance Audit

healthy_findings: No Telescope or Debugbar packages detected
Many lookup indexes already present on ca_masters and ocr_parsed_firms

critical.title: Shared host CPU saturation (load ~22–24)
critical.function: OS scheduler / PHP-FPM pool / neighboring tenants
critical.estimated_performance_impact: Severe. Load >20 queues requests for CPU even when SQL is fast; typically 2–10× TTFB inflation under contention.
critical.recommended_fix: Move to dedicated/VPS with reserved CPU/RAM; reduce concurrent cron load; re-check uptime after app fixes.

critical.title: QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync with no workers
critical.function: Job dispatch path (ShouldQueue jobs run inline)
critical.estimated_performance_impact: Critical. OCR/bulk/campaign jobs block HTTP PHP workers; freezes UI for concurrent employees.
critical.recommended_fix: Set QUEUE_CONNECTION=database (or Redis); run persistent queue:work; keep APP_DEBUG=false.

critical.title: Master/leads list runs 10+ unbounded activity queries per page
critical.query: SELECT * FROM call_logs WHERE ca_id IN (...); same unbounded get() for follow_up_histories, follow_ups, lead_actions, assignment_histories, email_logs, email_inbound_messages, wa_message_logs, sms_logs, lead_quality_histories, plus ca_masters (no LIMIT; PHP picks latest)
critical.estimated_performance_impact: Critical on every Master Data / Leads listing: ~10–11 round-trips + large hydration + PHP sort per request.
critical.recommended_fix: Denormalize last_activity_at/type on ca_masters, or one UNION ALL MAX per ca_id; never load full histories for list summaries.

critical.title: last_activity_at sort uses 12-branch correlated subquery
critical.query: ORDER BY (SELECT MAX(v) FROM (SELECT called_at FROM call_logs WHERE ca_id = ca_masters.ca_id UNION ALL …11 sources…))
critical.estimated_performance_impact: Critical when sorting by Last Activity on 137k rows; multi-second or timeout risk for page 1.
critical.recommended_fix: Persist indexed last_activity_at; ORDER BY that column; remove UNION subquery sort.

critical.title: Unminified ~2.5MB CRM UI payload on every page
critical.function: Full SPA script include list (all modules every authenticated page)
critical.estimated_performance_impact: Critical perceived load: parse/compile of 1MB+ JS blocks interactivity; worse under Hostinger latency.
critical.recommended_fix: Bundle/minify/code-split by route; gzip/brotli; defer OCR/demos/reports until those pages open.

high.title: Config/route/view caches not built on live
high.estimated_performance_impact: High: tens–hundreds of ms per request reparsing config/routes under load.
high.recommended_fix: php artisan config:cache && route:cache && view:cache after deploy.

high.title: File session + file cache drivers
high.query: Filesystem I/O under storage/framework/sessions and storage/framework/cache
high.estimated_performance_impact: High with concurrent employees: lock contention and disk I/O; orphaned file cache keys after version bumps.
high.recommended_fix: Use database or Redis for session and cache.

high.title: ?all=1 / max_all=5000 catalog loads
high.query: GET listings with all=1 → SELECT … LIMIT 5000 (ca-masters, employees, lead-assignments, follow-ups, lookups)
high.estimated_performance_impact: High: multi-MB JSON + heavy serialization; often after invalidateDataCaches reloads.
high.recommended_fix: Lower max_all for heavy resources; typeahead endpoints; stop full CA master catalog reloads for dropdowns.

high.title: max_per_page allows up to 1000
high.query: Paginated ca_masters with per_page=1000 plus activity fan-out (C3)
high.estimated_performance_impact: High: one user can monopolize DB/PHP.
high.recommended_fix: Cap UI and API at 50–100 for ca_masters.

high.title: OCR geo fallback on each list page
high.query: SELECT crm_ca_id, matched_ca_id, city, state FROM ocr_parsed_firms WHERE crm_ca_id IN (...) OR matched_ca_id IN (...) ORDER BY mapped_at DESC, id DESC
high.estimated_performance_impact: High when city/state missing on masters against 114k OCR rows.
high.recommended_fix: Copy city/state onto ca_masters at map/approve; remove list-time OCR fallback.

high.title: Global dashboard cache invalidation on writes
high.estimated_performance_impact: High under concurrency: all users recompute dashboard aggregates after single-lead writes.
high.recommended_fix: Scope invalidation by employee/org; Redis tags/TTL; avoid org-wide bumps for single edits.

high.title: Case-insensitive search cannot use normal indexes
high.query: WHERE LOWER(column) LIKE LOWER('%…%') plus whereHas on city/state/source/team
high.estimated_performance_impact: High on 137k-row Master search: full scans + EXISTS subqueries.
high.recommended_fix: Search normalized_* indexed columns with prefix/FULLTEXT; avoid LOWER() on indexed columns.

high.title: Partners eager-loaded on every listing row
high.query: SELECT * FROM ca_master_partners WHERE ca_id IN (...)
high.estimated_performance_impact: Medium–High: bloated list API when many partners exist.
high.recommended_fix: Load partners only on detail/drawer endpoints.

high.title: Minute-level scheduler load on shared hosting
high.estimated_performance_impact: High on load=20+ hosts: cron competes with HTTP for CPU.
high.recommended_fix: Keep cron healthy; use async queues; reduce unused every-minute jobs; never run heavy OCR in web requests.

medium.title: Sales import files(): full GROUP BY then PHP pagination
medium.query: SELECT source_file_name, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE…) FROM sales_import_rows GROUP BY source_file_name, import_batch_id → get() + Collection slice; plus status GROUP BY and DISTINCT employees
medium.estimated_performance_impact: Medium now (0 rows); High when large CSV batches return.
medium.recommended_fix: SQL LIMIT/OFFSET pagination; materialize stats on master_import_batches.

medium.title: Duplicate/redundant indexes on ca_masters
medium.query: Duplicate (status, created_at); redundant status / city_id singles vs composites
medium.recommended_fix: Drop duplicate composite; review redundant singles covered by composites.

medium.title: Lucide loaded from unpkg CDN every page
medium.estimated_performance_impact: Medium: extra DNS/TLS and third-party latency.
medium.recommended_fix: Self-host Lucide or icon subset on same origin.

medium.title: Large JSON list resources
medium.estimated_performance_impact: Medium: larger responses slow clients and table paint.
medium.recommended_fix: Slim list DTO; enrich on drawer open.

medium.title: activity_logs growth / subject filter indexes
medium.query: module/action/date indexed; subject/ca-style filters may scan
medium.recommended_fix: Align indexes to real WHERE clauses; archive old logs.

medium.title: Mail/SMTP during request path under sync queue
medium.estimated_performance_impact: Medium: SMTP RTT blocks request under sync.

medium.title: ocr_parsed_firms large table pressure
medium.estimated_performance_impact: Medium for OCR screens; secondary for Master via H5.
medium.recommended_fix: Archive mapped rows; tighten covering indexes; avoid dual-column OR without indexes.

low.title: Laravel logs not excessive
low.recommended_fix: Keep LOG_LEVEL=error; rotate if debug re-enabled.

low.title: sales_import_rows and call_logs empty today
low.estimated_performance_impact: Low now; C3/M1 patterns still latent risk.
low.recommended_fix: Fix code paths before next large import.

low.title: OPcache memory ~33MB
low.recommended_fix: Raise opcache.memory_consumption if hit rate drops (ops).

low.title: PHP-FPM/MySQL knobs not directly inspectable on shared plan
low.estimated_performance_impact: Unknown; shared plans usually under-provision vs 137k-row CRM.
low.recommended_fix: Request host metrics / upgrade; optional temporary slow-query log (ops).

remediation_order: C5/H3/H4 frontend minify and catalog caps
